turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Acme. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to check the status of my account

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I have a problem with my subscription

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: apparently it has been removed but I want to remain subscribed

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, let me see if I can clear this up for you

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ok thanks

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I ask your full name before we begin?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah my name is Domingo Rodriguez

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Domingo Rodriguez.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And you received an email saying that your subscription has been removed?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: not sure my wife told me about this issue

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: she was the one who told me the subscription had been removed

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: A reason of spouse has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see, well I can definitely check on your account status while we're here

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok thanks

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Well the good news is, our system is showing that your account is still active, and in good health

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh great news! I guess my wife made a mistake then

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will tease her about it no doubt

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: so everything is ok right?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, everything is okay on our end.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: glad to hear that

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm not sure how I would break the news, but it appears that your wife was mistaken

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will break the news with comedy lol

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sounds good

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thanks a lot for your service

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: no that would be it

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Very good. Thanks for contacting us, Mr. Domingo

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thank you

agentic.summary: Audit of agent turns 0-30: No policy violations found. The agent verified the account by pulling it up, asked only allowed personal data (full name), did not request or disclose payment or sensitive data, made no improper promises, handled no escalation requests improperly, and maintained acceptable conduct.

full.summary: Audit of conversation between agent and customer regarding subscription status. No agent violations observed: appropriate identity lookup occurred, only necessary personal data requested, no payment or sensitive data requested or disclosed, no improper promises, escalations or conduct issues.

rag.summary: Audit of a 31-turn conversation. The agent pulled the account but proceeded to check subscription status without completing full verification required for subscription/order issues, and did not offer an escalation route after the customer reported a problem with their subscription. No personal/payment data or promises policy violations were found, and agent conduct was acceptable.

findings.quote: I see, well I can definitely check on your account status while we're here
findings.explanation: For subscription or order status issues the policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID). Although the account was pulled up (system turn 9: 'Account has been pulled up for Domingo Rodriguez'), the agent proceeded to check status without asking for the required account ID and order ID.

findings.quote: I see, well I can definitely check on your account status while we're here
findings.explanation: The customer stated they had a problem with their subscription (turn 3). The agent acknowledged and offered to check the account but did not offer the escalation route (supervisor/complaint form/internal team) as required when a customer makes a complaint.

findings.quote: Very good. Thanks for contacting us, Mr. Domingo
findings.explanation: The agent closed the conversation without offering an escalation route or explicitly confirming how the customer could escalate the complaint if unresolved.
